properties.name: circular
properties.description: Some cell's formula refers back to itself, directly or through other cells.

properties.name: dangling
properties.description: Some formula refers to a cell the sheet doesn't have.

types.description: A CSV export: one file, in/csv/<name>.csv, with a name that isn't empty or only white space; one row of the sheet per line.
A spreadsheet: one file per cell under in/sheet/, holding a number or a formula.

transforms.name: looped
transforms.description: The first cell in cell order, row by row then column by column, replaced by a reference to itself, so the sheet has a cycle.

transforms.name: renamed
transforms.description: Every cell moved one row down, A1 to A2, with every reference rewritten to the moved cell.

lifts.name: import
lifts.description: Turns each CSV field into a cell: row 1, field 2 is B1.

outputs.description: The line the importer can't read, and why.

productFiles.description: One file per cell, as a sheet's in/sheet/ holds them.

outputs.description: The cell that is neither a number nor a formula.

suites.name: format
suites.description: Prints each formula back in canonical form.

outputs.description: Each formula cell and its formula, in cell order.
